source_excerpts.text:
I have not resolved the full generative sampling proposition. I have neither constructed an  $\eta_{\mathrm{sample}}>0$  covering every allowed schedule and preparation nor established a native, robust additive-TV hardness reduction.

This turn does establish two complete sampling operations under additional hypotheses, together with a native rare-output bound and a precise limitation of one logarithmic resummation. The main positive result is a polynomial-bit sampler for sufficiently short native evolution with a balanced preparation–measurement boundary, including general multiqubit GKLS perturbations and arbitrary rational piecewise schedules. The second operation sums arbitrarily many disconnected contributions in a tensor representation whose measurement pins satisfy a uniform quantitative condition. Neither condition is established for the full input class.

The complete proofs, constants, arithmetic construction and source-scope record are in generative_sampling_pinning_resummation_return_20261108.txt.

1. A complete native sampler under a balanced measurement boundary

Write the supplied product preparation as  $\rho_0=\bigotimes_i\rho_i$ , and the one-site POVM effects as  $M_i(x)$ . Define

 $p_i(x)=\operatorname{Tr}(M_i(x)\rho_i),
\qquad
t_i(x)=\frac{\operatorname{Tr}M_i(x)}2.$ The additional hypothesis is a fixed rational  $\lambda>0$  such that, for every nonzero effect,

 $\boxed{\quad p_i(x)\ge \lambda\,t_i(x).\quad} \tag{1}$ This is a relative overlap condition. It allows individual outcome probabilities to be exponentially small in their encoding length, provided the corresponding effect is proportionately small. It holds for every POVM when  $\rho_i\ge\lambda I/2$ . It does not hold for arbitrary pure preparations and arbitrary measurements.

The construction extends the balanced-boundary short-time method of Yin and Lucas. Their Section 4 explicitly imposes an overlap condition; their time-dependent formulation has its own temporal representation requirements. The construction here handles the actual rational piecewise schedule and the local GKLS terms directly. arxiv.org [https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.10929?utm_source=chatgpt.com]
